summary: Verified sign-out (customer + admin, desktop + mobile), Back-icon navigation, Home service-card destinations, Services page 10-row destinations, and 4 generic ServiceDetail pages (Software Development, Data Analysis, AI Integration, Remote IT Consultation). Invalid slug redirects to /services. Regression: /obc and /documentation-assistance still render. One functional issue found: Back icon on a directly-loaded detail page does NOT fall back to Home; it navigates to about:blank because window.history.length includes the initial blank entry.

ui_bugs.issue: goBack() uses window.history.length > 1 which is truthy for direct navigations (initial about:blank counts as an entry), so on a fresh tab opened at /services/software-development, clicking Back navigates to about:blank instead of falling back to Home ('/'). Spec explicitly requires Home fallback for direct links.

action_items: Fix Navbar.goBack fallback for direct links. Recommended: use react-router's useNavigationType() === 'POP' with location.key === 'default' (fresh entry) OR track an internal-navigation ref, then navigate('/') when no in-app history exists. Example: `const navType = useNavigationType(); const isFresh = location.key === 'default'; ... if (!isFresh) navigate(-1); else navigate('/');`
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.jsx goBack: window.history.length includes the browser's initial entry (about:blank), so >1 check is unreliable for detecting in-app history. Use react-router state (location.key === 'default') instead.
AuthContext.logout swallows errors silently (`catch {}`). Acceptable for UX, but consider logging in dev to detect broken logout endpoint.

After signout from /dashboard or /admin, users land on /login rather than / because the protected page redirects on user===false racing navigate('/'). Not a spec failure (session is cleared and /api/auth/me returns 401) but spec said 'lands on Home'. Consider adding an early `navigate('/','replace')` before setUser(false), or gate the redirect in Dashboard/Admin to skip if pathname changed.
ServiceDetail Navigate to /services on unknown slug works correctly; verified with /services/does-not-exist-xyz.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified all Home service cards route to specific pages: SRV-01..08 -> /services/<slug>, SRV-09 -> /obc, SRV-10 -> /documentation-assistance. Same for Services page rows. Detail pages for software-development, data-analysis, ai-integration, remote-it-consultation each render 5 included cards, 4 process steps, 4 outcome cards; Book/Quote CTAs prefill ?service=<Title>. Sign-out works for both roles on desktop and mobile; /api/auth/me returns 401 after logout. Back button hidden on Home (location.pathname==='/'), visible on all non-home pages. KNOWN BUG: on a directly-loaded detail page (fresh tab) the Back button leads to about:blank because window.history.length===2 (about:blank + current page). Reproduced at /services/software-development in a fresh browser context. Facebook heartbeat 401s remain out of scope.
rca of the issue: Navbar.goBack() logic: `if (window.history.length > 1) navigate(-1); else navigate('/')`. When the user opens the detail URL directly, the browser session's history stack begins with about:blank (or the previous cross-site page) plus the current page, so history.length is >=2 and navigate(-1) goes there. Correct detection of an 'in-app' first entry requires react-router's location.key === 'default' or a top-level ref that increments on internal navigations. Reproduction: open a new tab, visit https://yobsman-preview.preview.emergentagent.com/services/software-development, wait for load, click the back-arrow icon in the navbar -> browser navigates to about:blank rather than /.
